error.network: The translation service is still starting up or is unavailable. Try again in a few minutes.
error.timeout: The translation service took too long to respond. Try again shortly.
error.unavailable: The configured translation backend is not available.
error.invalidResponse: The translation service returned something I couldn't read.
error.generic: Something went wrong while translating. Please try again.
error.rateLimited.user: You have asked for a lot of translations just now. Try again in {seconds} seconds.
error.rateLimited.guild: This server has used up its translations for the hour. Try again later.
translate.unknownLanguage: I don't know a language called "{name}".
translate.noText: That message has no text to translate.
mention.hint: Reply to the message you want translated and @mention me. Add a language to pick the target (`@bot french`), or `source:target` to force the source too (`@bot fr:en`, `@bot fr:`).
mention.unreadable: I couldn't read the message you replied to.
reaction.unsupported: I don't have a language for {flag}. Pick a target below.
select.expired: The original text is no longer available to translate.
reply.title: Translation
reply.uncertain.name: The source language is a guess
reply.uncertain.value: Pick the source in the menus below, reply with `@bot <source>:<target>` (e.g. `fr:en`), or use `/translate` with its `source` option.
cmd.translate.description: Translate some text (reply visible only to you)
cmd.translate.target: Target language (defaults to your Discord language); also accepts {form}, e.g. {example}
cmd.translate.source: Source language, when auto-detection gets it wrong
cmd.translateMessage.name: Translate Message
cmd.help.description: List the supported languages and their codes
help.title: Supported languages
help.intro: Use any name or code below as the target, or `source:target` to force the source too.
help.usage: React with a flag, reply to a message and @mention me (`@bot`, `@bot fr:en`), use `/translate`, or right-click a message and pick Apps, then Translate Message.
help.flags: React to a message with a country flag and I post it in that language for the channel. Flags that share a language are one request: {flags} all ask for English, so only the first one posts. If I have no language for a flag, I answer with a menu instead.
